reason: The remediation modifies the bootloader configuration to add a kernel parameter (init_on_free=1). Bootloader changes can prevent the system from booting if the parameter is unsupported or incorrectly applied, potentially causing loss of SSH/console access. Policy classifies bootloader/kernel parameter changes as too dangerous to remediate automatically.
estimated_impact: reboot required; Potential boot failure; Kernel incompatibility with init_on_free; Loss of remote access if system fails to boot
